elsewhere.note: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,
The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself…
